label: v1.0 checkpoints (partial-derivative residual), derivative audit, SI table S5

definitions.partial_mse: mean squared scale-normalised ASM1 residual with dZ/dt taken in t alone (v1.0 training quantity)
definitions.total_mse: same residual with dZ/dt along the influent trajectory, dZ/dt|_u + J_q q' + J_z z'
definitions.influent_share_scaled_median: median over points of ||(J_q q' + J_z z')/s|| / ||(dZ/dt)_total/s||, s = component scale
definitions.random_segment: uniform random times, segment slopes of the linear interpolant (the v1.1 training quantity)
definitions.knots_central: grid knots, np.gradient slopes (the review-panel probe); central slopes average two segments, so ratios sit 1.3-1.9x below random_segment
